google_play.title: Thalika: Calorie Counter
google_play.short: Free calorie tracker for Indian, French and American food, with photo estimates.
google_play.full:
Thalika is a simple, free calorie tracker built for people who eat Indian, French and American food.

Search more than 17,000 foods from open nutrition tables: the Indian Nutrient Databank for dishes like idli, rajma and paneer paratha, the French ANSES-CIQUAL table for croissants, quiche and ratatouille, and USDA tables for everyday American food and ingredients. Pick a portion such as 1 roti, 1 bowl or 1 slice, and Thalika does the maths.

Snap your plate to log a meal from a photo. Each item is listed with its estimated weight and matched to the food table, and you can fix any weight or match before it goes in your diary. Photo estimates use your own Claude API key, so there is no subscription.

What you get
- A daily calorie target from your height, weight, activity and goal
- Calories left, protein, carbs and fat at a glance
- Breakfast, snacks, lunch and dinner in one diary
- Quick calories, your own foods, and packaged foods from Open Food Facts
- Water and weight tracking with a 7 and 30 day view
- Dark mode

Your data stays on your device. There is no account. Back up your diary to a file, or delete everything in three taps.

Thalika is a food diary, not medical advice.
